seo.meta: Compare Online MBA options for 2026-27. Check eligibility, fees, syllabus, specialisations, admission, exams, careers and universities.

online-mba.intro: An Online MBA is a postgraduate management programme delivered through an online learning model. It is useful for learners who want management education without following a conventional campus schedule. The right choice depends less on the label “online” and more on the university, curriculum, assessment model, total cost, specialisation and support structure.
online-mba.fees_guidance: There is no single universal fee for Online MBA. The directory below should pull the current programme fee from each university-course record and show “Not published” where the official amount is not currently verified.
online-mba.curriculum_guidance: Common management concepts can be explained at course level, but the actual semester syllabus must remain university-specific. Use the programme records below for the authoritative subject lists.
online-mba.admission_guidance: Admission requirements and dates can differ by university and session. Use the exact programme page for the current application cycle, documents and selection rules.
online-mba.exam_guidance: Do not assume one exam model applies to every university. Show the documented assessment/proctoring pattern from the university research layer.
online-mba.career_guidance: Career outcomes from Online MBA depend on the learner's skills, experience and target role. Use role families as guidance rather than salary or placement guarantees.
